findings.title: Double-clicking "Water now" records two waterings
findings.steps: On /beds, slow POST /api/waterings by 800 ms, then click "Water now" for North bed twice quickly.
findings.expected: One watering is recorded. The button is disabled while saving and/or the server deduplicates (for example with an idempotency key).
findings.actual: Two POST requests go out and two waterings are created about 2 s apart. The button is never disabled; only its label changes to "Watering…". recordWatering has no in-flight guard, and the server has no idempotency key.
findings.evidence: Playwright counted posts=2 and isDisabled()=false right after the first click. The API list then showed ids 5 and 6, both North bed, at 09:44:13 and 09:44:15.

findings.title: Watering requests have no timeout; a hung POST leaves "Watering…" forever
findings.steps: Make POST /api/waterings hang (route with no response) and click "Water now" for Shade corner. Wait 12 s.
findings.expected: After 10 s the request fails and the page shows an error with a way to retry.
findings.actual: After 12 s the button still says "Watering…" and no error appears. useApiClient sets no timeout, so the same applies to GET /api/waterings and DELETE.
findings.evidence: Button texts after 12 s included "Watering…\nShade corner" and no role=alert was present.

findings.title: Waterings page and dashboard error states have no retry
findings.steps: Navigate inside the app (client side) to the dashboard and then to Waterings while GET /api/waterings returns 500.
findings.expected: An error message plus a Retry button that refetches without reloading the page.
findings.actual: Only 'Could not load recent waterings.' / 'Could not load waterings.' is shown, with no button. The dashboard does not even destructure refresh for waterings. The only way to recover is a full reload.
findings.evidence: Buttons inside the dashboard waterings section: []. Buttons in main on /waterings: [].

findings.title: Beds fetch failure on the Waterings page is silent; the filter just shows 'All beds'
findings.steps: Navigate client side to /waterings while GET /api/beds returns 500.
findings.expected: A visible message that beds could not be loaded, with a retry.
findings.actual: The bed select silently contains only 'All beds'. bedsResult.error is never read.
findings.evidence: The page text showed 'Bed / All beds' with no alert about beds.

findings.title: Large bed_id or watering id causes a 500 instead of a 4xx
findings.actual: 500 Internal Server Error, because SQLite overflows on integers larger than 64 bits. No upper bound is validated.
findings.evidence: curl returned 'Internal Server Error 500' for all three requests.

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts are accepted but shown as '0 L'
findings.where: /beds Record past watering form; /waterings and dashboard Amount column
findings.steps: Record a past watering with litres 0.0001. The form has novalidate, and the JS only checks > 0 and ignores min=0.1.
findings.expected: The amount is refused with a reason (for example a minimum of 0.1 L), or shown accurately.
findings.actual: It is saved and displayed as '0 L', because formatLitres uses maximumFractionDigits 2.
findings.evidence: The watering list showed a row '12 Nov 2026, 10:43  North bed  0 L' for a 0.0001 L entry. It was created through the API; the frontend validation lets the same value through.

findings.title: Absurd past dates such as year 0001 are accepted
findings.expected: Implausible dates are refused with a visible reason.
findings.actual: 201 Created. The entry then sorts as the oldest watering, and the date input has no min.

findings.title: Invalid ?bed= in the URL shows a raw validation message and an empty-looking filter
findings.expected: The invalid filter is ignored or reset, or a friendly message is shown.
findings.actual: The page shows 'Query.bed id: Input should be a valid integer, unable to parse string as an integer' while the select matches no option.
findings.evidence: The page text included that message.
